title: Creating a relaxing downhill game with Astra.
author: madasket

comments.author: MunchyCerealGuy
comments.body:
The gameplay video doesn't quite read as relaxing to me, unfortunately.

I think it's because going that fast with nothing between you and the tarmac registers as dangerous to my psychologically. It's same feeling I get from skateboarding, skating, or mountain biking. Speed plus exposure is a scary combination

replies.author: madasket
replies.body: Maybe you’re right, you’re not the first person who says this) I guess, I find this relaxing because I tested the game and got used to speed and control. But I’ll think about game positioning and its name. Thanks for review!
